materials.story: Estash is an intelligent blend of wool, polyester, and viscose. Viscose gives breathability and softness. Wool is there with its well-known properties of warmth, absorbency, and elegant look. Polyester adds strength and longevity. Properties of all three fibers make it a perfect yet economical suiting option. Fabric: TRW Tropical Wool — A blend of wool, polyester, and viscose.
